name: Sun TV Network Ltd.
about: Sun TV Network Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in producing and broadcasting satellite television and radio software programming in the regional languages. The company's flagship channel is Sun TV. It also operates various other satellite channels, such as Surya TV, Gemini TV, Udaya TV, SUN Bangla, Sun Neo, and Sun Marathi; 24 frequency modulation radio stations; SunRisers Hyderabad, an Indian Premier League franchise; Sun Risers Eastern Cape, a South Africa Premier League franchise; and SUNNXT, an OTT platform. In addition, the company offers daily newspapers and magazines. It provides entertainment in various genres of general entertainment, movies, music, news, kids, and lifestyle. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~16% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~5% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 18 is near the top of its range over the last 3 years (median 14).
Since 2023, most of the 13% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 11 → 18), not earnings growth (-3% a year).
